title: GTA 6 Arrives in 2026 with Massive Map and Collector's Prices
seoTitle: GTA 6 Arrives in 2026 with Massive Map and High Prices
subtitle: What lies behind the anticipation for Rockstar's new game
excerpt: GTA 6, announced for 2026, features a map twice the size of GTA 5, a collector's price of nearly 400 reais, and delays that left fans curious.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The release of GTA 6, scheduled for November 19, 2026, has been the most talked-about topic among open-world game fans. The anticipation stems from a map twice the size of GTA 5, a collector's price reaching nearly 400 reais, and delays that have left the community curious about what lies behind this major title.

Map that doubles expectations

According to analyses of trailers and 2026 material, GTA 6's map spans around 300 to 340 square kilometers, nearly double the size of Los Santos and Blaine County in GTA 5. Rockstar emphasizes that content density is higher, with approximately 600,000 NPC animations, compared to 55,000 in GTA 5.

Collector's price without the game

Rockstar opened pre-orders for the “Vice City Collection,” a collector's set that costs 399.99 dollars (or 349.99 pounds in the UK) and does not include a copy of GTA 6. The package contains items branded with Vice City, GTA 6, or Rockstar, such as t-shirts, tote bags, and hats. The set is sold only as a complete bundle.

Delays fueling curiosity

The game was delayed twice: in May 2025, when Rockstar pushed the release date to fall 2025, and in November 2025, when the company announced a new deadline of November 2026. The reasons cited were technical complexity and the need to avoid crunch periods.

Versions and platform requirements

GTA 6 will launch exclusively for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S. There are no PC requirements yet, but Rockstar typically follows the pattern of releasing the PC version one year after the console release. The title is expected to take up between 100 and 200 gigabytes on an SSD.

How the hype is building

Interest in GTA 6 surged when Rockstar revealed the collector's price and the promise of a massive map. Fans are tracking updates via trailers, leaks, and Rockstar's social channels, awaiting more details about the new gaming experience.

With information from Red Bull, gHacks.
